# Tender Response — RTL-2026-07
**Visakoivu Oy** to Rantatuote Logistiikka Oy

## 3. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds public liability insurance above the required EUR 1,000,000, and our equity ratio meets the required 20% minimum.

## 4. Technical requirements

**4.1 Escalation procedure.** Faults not resolved on first visit are escalated to a technical lead, and to the service manager if unresolved after 48 hours.

**4.2 Personnel qualifications.** Visakoivu Oy fields a large LVI team of approximately 104 qualified technicians, giving strong depth of cover for a logistics operation running extended hours, alongside qualified sähkö and rakennusautomaatio staff.

## 5. Commercial terms

**5.1 Pricing structure.** We propose a fixed monthly price covering scheduled maintenance across the properties in Appendix 2, with corrective work charged separately on a time and materials basis at agreed rates.

**5.2 Invoicing.** Monthly invoicing, itemised by property and by discipline, issued in arrears against completed work.

## 6. Submission requirements

**6.1** Visakoivu Oy operates an established quality management system covering scheduled and corrective maintenance work.

## Annex A

**A.1** Lift maintenance is carried out in compliance with applicable statutory requirements, using qualified subcontracted lift engineers where required.

**A.2** Periodic inspection of electrical installations is scheduled and documented in line with statutory intervals, carried out by our qualified sähkö team.

Visakoivu Oy is a 180-person technical and facility services company operating across LVI, sähkö, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistönhoito disciplines. We thank Rantatuote Logistiikka Oy for the opportunity to tender and look forward to supporting the properties covered by this contract.
